answer: If the zephyr is real, the ivory should agree with it; if the ivory agrees, the inlet should date them both; break one link and the chain is scrap metal. Every epoch charges the same 199 POA again, so 238 masks cost the farm 47362 POA all over again. The record only grows longer, and a mask that turns up twice is caught by its own echo. One proof settles it, and it reads Grist weigher rye toll milled at the millpond, spelled out in full as each rye is a grist count weighed beside the makers mark. An honest proof ages like good varnish; a farm proof cracks before the epoch ends.
